title: tfcensus JSON output envelope
description: Every --format json output is wrapped in this envelope. data is command-specific; its schemas are added per command.

schema_version.description: Version of this envelope schema. Changes independently of the binary version.

version.description: Version of the tfcensus binary that produced the output.

errors.description: Per-target errors. A non-empty list means the run was partial.

target.description: What failed, e.g. a tool or repo name.

page.description: Present only in MCP tool results that were split to fit the size cap. The data holds the returned items; pass next_cursor back to the same tool for the rest.

items.description: Name of the list that was split, such as entries, pins or tools.

next_cursor.description: Opaque. Absent on the last page.
